_comment: Mars science targets (spec: Science targets and downlink; UI rules 39-43). Each target has a location, a one-line lesson, a science weight (game estimate; the six sum to 1), what its picture needs, and one real NASA image checked against its catalogue page on Oct 23, 2026. Image copies are made by scripts/fetch-targets.py into public/targets/ and public/mars/. JPL Image Use Policy: images on JPL public sites may be used for any purpose without prior permission, except third-party images (credits naming a university), whose owners allow journalistic, educational and personal use only.
